development.distribution: 8 cases in each family, spanning factual grounding, rewrites, constraints, follow-up, ambiguity, tool abstention/boundaries, structured extraction, decisions with limits, single calls, chains, error result use, and result use.

integrity.rubrics: Prose checks are diagnostic plus manual review; tool checks require model-emitted, ordered exact calls/arguments, fixture execution only for permitted calls, and a separately scored final answer.

limitations: Both suites are assistant-authored evaluation artifacts, not independent benchmarks.
No model outputs have been generated or reviewed in this preparation.
Passing preparation checks does not establish model quality.
